name: ensure running-task cleanup executes on cancellation
definition: Guarantee that when the process is interrupted, the in-flight job's finally/cleanup code still completes before the program exits.
failure_mode: Using a pool executor (thread/process) that kills or the cleanup is not awaited on cancellation.

name: expose the engine headers on the preprocessor include path
definition: Add the directory holding the engine's public header to the compile include path cpath so clang can find it.
failure_mode: missing include path makes compilation fail before execution

name: keep a generated gate definition within a hard size (line-count) limit
definition: The produced network must stay under a declared maximum number of lines when the update step cap is 32000, so it fits the simulator's processing bounds.
failure_mode: Oversized generated net that exceeds processing/default constraints.

name: normalize masks into single contiguous non-overlapping polylines
definition: Postprocess SVM raw outputs so each extracted contour is a single connected region, does not overlap others beyond a tiny tolerance, and is no longer the trivial rectangle that was the prompt.
failure_mode: Rectangle outputs, overlapping or multi-part masks fail the geometry asserts.
